subject: POC: headless adapter handshake delay — request for trial extension and credits
messages:
From: Lola Barnes <lola@synthixlabs.com>
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: Aaron Kim <aaron.kim@synthixlabs.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 23:12:00 -0800
Subject: POC blocker — headless adapter handshake failing, asking for trial extension

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for spinning up the POC environment so quickly. We hit a blocker late Friday while swapping our headless adapter into the streaming path — the adapter fails TLS handshake intermittently when shard routing is enabled (error trace attached). Our infra lead (Aaron) dug in and believes this will take a couple of sprints to resolve because it touches our service-mesh sidecar logic and requires an upstream patch.

Given the delay, we need a little runway to complete the integration and run the usage tests you requested. Can Redwood provide a 45-day extension on the trial window and a small promo credit so we can finish end-to-end load testing? If helpful, I can share the error logs and a short recording of the failing flow.

We love what we see from Redwood so far — low latency on the smaller models has been impressive — and want to keep momentum. Appreciate any help you can provide to prevent the PoC from stalling.

Best,
Lola Barnes
Head of Integrations, Synthix Labs

Attachments: integration_log_excerpt.txt (text), adapter_arch_diagram.pdf (pdf)
From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
To: Lola Barnes <lola@synthixlabs.com>
Cc: Aaron Kim <aaron.kim@synthixlabs.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: POC blocker — headless adapter handshake failing, asking for trial extension

Hi Lola — thanks for the clear notes and the logs. Sorry to hear you ran into the handshake issue. Aaron, thanks for the extra context — that servicing sidecar + shard routing combination makes sense as the culprit.

We can absolutely help so the PoC stays on track. Proposed options:
- Option A (fast): 30-day trial extension + $300 promo credits to cover load tests and smoke runs. We can enable this today.
- Option B (larger runway): 45-day extension + $600 credits, requires manager sign-off.

To move quickly I'd like to enable Option A now and queue a manager approval request for Option B if you still need more time after the 30 days.

Next steps from our side: I will loop in Karthik (infra) to review the logs and confirm whether a Redwood config change or a Synthix patch is the faster fix; Laura (your AE) will follow on credits/contract implications.

If you can confirm which option you prefer, we’ll take care of the rest.

Thanks — Mateo
Mateo Alvarez | Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com
To: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: POC blocker — headless adapter handshake failing, asking for trial extension

Team — forwarding a customer ask from Synthix. They’re requesting a 45-day extension + credits because a headless adapter handshake failure is blocking verification tests. I proposed a 30-day extension + $300 credits as an immediate help and flagged a manager sign-off path for 45d/$600.

Quick context: the logs point to intermittent TLS failures when shard routing + sidecar are enabled; Aaron suspects a timing/race inside their sidecar. Can you do a quick triage on the attached excerpt to confirm whether a Redwood router tweak could reduce the failure rate? If our runtime can accept a config change that masks the issue for now, we can keep their PoC moving without a larger credit commitment.

Requested:
- Karthik: Can you validate whether a router config / handshake timeout tweak is feasible and low-risk to roll into their POC instance? Rough ETA?
- Laura: If Karthik confirms we can mitigate with a config, I’d like to approve Option A immediately. If not, please advise on manager path for Option B (who to ping and what doc to attach).

Deal link: https://crm.redwood.com/deals/SYN-2026-348
Logs: attached (integration_log_excerpt.txt)

Thanks,
Mateo
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: mateo.alvarez@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Lola Barnes <lola@synthixlabs.com>, Aaron Kim <aaron.kim@synthixlabs.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 17:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: POC blocker — headless adapter handshake failing, asking for trial extension

Hi all — quick update and approved path.

Karthik: I reviewed the logs offline with infra — we can implement a handshake timeout increase and a conservative routing backoff on the POC instance; that will dramatically reduce the intermittent failures while Synthix issues the sidecar patch. Karthik confirmed the change is low-risk and reversible.

Decision: Approve Option A immediately — 30-day extension + $300 promo credits (applied today).
If Synthix still needs the 45-day runway after those 30 days, escalate to finance for the additional $300 credits and a manager approval (Deal ID SYN-2026-348).

Lola — I’ve applied the credits and extended your trial window by 30 days. You should see the credits applied in the portal and I asked infra to push the routing tweak to your POC cluster this evening. Please monitor for reduced failures and confirm when you’ve re-run your tests.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
